questions.prompt: List all the factors of each number, in order, separated by commas.
questions.explanation: $24 = 1 \times 24 = 2 \times 12 = 3 \times 8 = 4 \times 6$. $25 = 1 \times 25 = 5 \times 5$ — a square number, so it has an odd number of factors.

questions.prompt: Put the steps for finding the HCF of 12 and 30 by prime factors in order.

items.text: Draw a factor tree for each number
Pick out the primes they share: 2 and 3

hints: You need the primes before you can compare them.
questions.explanation: Factor trees → prime products → shared primes → multiply. The HCF of 12 and 30 is 6.

questions.prompt: Find the highest common factor of each set.
questions.explanation: 10, 4, 6 and 18. For the last pair the shared primes are $2 \times 3 \times 3 = 18$.

questions.prompt: Find the lowest common multiple of 12 and 30.
hints: Use each prime the most times it appears in either number: $2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5$.

questions.prompt: Match each fraction to its simplest form.
hints: Divide top and bottom by the HCF.

questions.prompt: Work out $\dfrac{18}{55} \times \dfrac{22}{63}$, cancelling first. Give your answer as a fraction in its simplest form.
Strings of 120 cm, 180 cm and 420 cm are cut into equal lengths with nothing left over. What is the greatest possible length of each piece?
hints: You need the HCF of 120, 180 and 420.

questions.prompt: Complete each sentence with one of: **prime**, **composite**, **square**, **factor**.
questions.text: 7 is a [[a]] number because its only factors are 1 and 7. 8 is a [[b]] number because it has more than two factors. 16 is a [[c]] number because it has an odd number of factors.
hints: Factors of 16: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 — how many is that?
questions.explanation: Prime (exactly two factors), composite (more than two), square (the middle factor pairs with itself, so the count is odd).

hints: How many factors does a prime have?
questions.explanation: False. A prime has exactly **two** factors. 1 has only one factor (itself), so it is not prime.

questions.prompt: My number is a factor of 20. Which statement is true?

options.text: It could be odd or even

questions.explanation: The factors of 20 are 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20 — some odd (1, 5), some even.
